668154.Description:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [De-Digivolve 2] 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, add this card to the hand.

[Main] You may link this card to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. Then, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon gains [Reboot] and +3000 DP.
Link Effect DP +2000
[Link] Lv. 3 or higher: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
[Blocker] (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)

668155.Description:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Until your turn ends, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend. Then, add this card to the hand.
[Main] You may link this card to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
Link Effect DP +2000
[Link] Lv. 3 or higher: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
[Jamming] (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)

668156.Description:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements. Security Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP. Then, add this card to the hand. Main You may link this card to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as 1 of your Digimon.
Link Effect DP +2000
Link Lv. 3 or higher: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon may attack.

668158.Description:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] By placing 1 Option card with the [Onmyojutsu] or [Plug-In] trait from your hand under this Tamer, Draw 1 and gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon] or [Sakuyamon] in its name attacks, by suspending this Tamer, you may use 1 [Onmyojutsu] or [Plug-In] trait Option card with as high or lower a use cost as that Digimon's level from under this Tamer without paying the cost.
668158.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

668160.Description:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects and gets -3000 DP.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may use 1 Option card with the [Onmyojutsu] or [Plug-In] trait from your hand or under your Tamers without paying the cost.
668160.Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By trashing your top security card, 1 of your Digimon with [Sakuyamon] in its name unsuspends.
